method.description: Statement-level SQL parse (line-comment, block-comment, single-quote, double-quote and dollar-quote aware) replaying CREATE POLICY / DROP POLICY in ordinal order across db/migrations/*.sql to derive the EFFECTIVE policy set; the same parse applied to the hosted baseline dump and to the db/policies and db/prepared corpora for lineage divergence.
method.predicate: current_user_is_super_admin() — plus, outside the migration lineage, a bare is_super_admin column reference
method.determinism: Category D (machine-derived; no LLM adjudication of any count in this file).
caveats: This censuses the DECLARED policy corpus in the repository at the stated tree. It is NOT a live pg_policies snapshot of staging or production.

lineage_divergence.finding: The three declared lineages do NOT agree on the superadmin policy surface. A successor that closes only db/migrations leaves the deployed and prepared surfaces open.

db_policies.note: db/policies adds ZERO NEW SUPERADMIN DISJUNCTS to the census union. That is the precise and only claim supported by the measurement, and it is what preserves the closed-world total of 140.

precision_correction_r2.supersedes: R1 stated that this 'mechanically confirms db/policies content is sourced into migrations 0031/0032 and adds no independent surface'. That was TOO STRONG and is withdrawn.
precision_correction_r2.why_the_union_total_is_unchanged: The single absent key that carries a superadmin disjunct is marketing_leads.super_admins_read_marketing_leads, which is ALREADY counted in the union under the HOSTED_BASELINE_ONLY lineage. It is therefore not a new disjunct, and the closed-world total remains 140. This is also why the automated check reported superadmin_outside_union = 0: the key was already in the union set, contributed by the baseline.

orphan_keys.note: Already in the union via HOSTED_BASELINE_ONLY. Adds no new disjunct. Corroborates CEN-01 from a SECOND non-migration lineage.

precision_correction_r2.consequence: db/policies is NOT merely a mirror of 0031/0032. Five of its keys have no counterpart in the effective migration lineage, and two of its tables (governed_model_registry, proxy_material_fields_registry) have no effective migration policies whatsoever. A successor MUST NOT treat db/policies as redundant with the migration lineage, even though it contributes no new superadmin disjunct.

db_prepared.note: All 18 RESTRICTIVE policies in the entire repository live here and NONE are in the effective migration lineage. The only existing RESTRICTIVE mechanism is therefore unapplied.

closed_world.statement: The successor implementation MUST close the UNION of all three declared lineages. Closing db/migrations alone is insufficient and MUST NOT be reported as closure.

rules.evaluation: First match wins, in the order OPERATOR_METADATA, GLOBAL_REFERENCE, TENANT_METADATA, OTHER, else TENANT_CONTENT.
rules.fail_closed: A table ambiguous between TENANT_CONTENT and TENANT_METADATA is classified TENANT_CONTENT — the more restrictive disposition. projects and portfolios are classified TENANT_CONTENT on this rule because they carry tenant-authored descriptive fields (e.g. projects.target_population_description, thematic_area, governance_regime), not merely structural ones.

open_findings.finding: marketing_leads is created with no RLS at all in the migration lineage; its only policies, including a superadmin read, exist solely in the hosted baseline.
open_findings.disposition: The successor MUST NOT treat the migration lineage as the closed world.

open_findings.finding: Zero RESTRICTIVE policies exist in the effective migration lineage. Every superadmin disjunct is therefore purely additive: it can only widen access, and no permissive weld can be narrowed by an existing RESTRICTIVE layer.
open_findings.disposition: Freezes the mechanism: a RESTRICTIVE successor layer must be introduced, it does not already exist in applied form.

open_findings.finding: 129 of 132 effective policies are TO PUBLIC. Role scoping is not currently load-bearing for the bypass.
open_findings.disposition: A role-based successor cannot rely on existing TO clauses.

open_findings.finding: RESOLVED BY MEASUREMENT. db/policies adds zero superadmin policies outside the union; db/prepared adds nine, and holds all 18 RESTRICTIVE policies.
open_findings.disposition: The nine prepared-only policies carry applied_status UNKNOWN and are inside the frozen closed world.

open_findings.finding: The census measures declared SQL, not a live database. No pg_policies snapshot of staging or production was taken under this authority.
open_findings.disposition: UNKNOWN — the successor MUST reconcile against a live snapshot before claiming closure. Fails closed.

open_findings.finding: R2 PRECISION. db/policies is not a pure mirror of the migration lineage: 5 of its 105 keys have no counterpart in the effective migration lineage, and two of its tables (governed_model_registry, proxy_material_fields_registry) have no effective migration policies at all. Only ONE orphan carries a superadmin disjunct — marketing_leads.super_admins_read_marketing_leads — and it is already counted under HOSTED_BASELINE_ONLY.
open_findings.disposition: The closed-world total of 140 is UNCHANGED: db/policies adds ZERO NEW superadmin disjuncts. But the R1 claim that it 'adds no independent surface' is WITHDRAWN — a successor MUST NOT treat db/policies as redundant with db/migrations. Corroborates CEN-01 from a second non-migration lineage.
